steps.speaker: Johnson
steps.content: Hilda, this is a rather... unconventional meeting place. Does it mean you've finally come around to my proposal?

steps.speaker: Johnson
steps.content: Well, well. Our "anomalous power expert" decided to join us. Don't tell me you're also here to get a cut, sir.
steps.female_content: Well, well. Our "anomalous power expert" decided to join us. Don't tell me you're also here to get a cut, ma'am.

steps.speaker: Johnson
steps.content: Look, my position hasn't changed. The price is negotiable, so long as I get out of this dump quickly. I'm losing money by the second just standing here.

While Johnson talks, his nervous gaze flits repeatedly toward the door, scanning the room for anything he could use as a weapon. He'd suspected Hilda's hostility, but your presence as her backup is an unwelcome surprise.
A silent look between you and Hilda confirms the plan. The "good cop, bad cop" routine is a go. Your role is the calm, reasonable interrogator; hers is the intimidating force.
